tasks.design: Configure current approved leaflets and encounter-header reuse in the clinical record {OTHER}. The midwife establishes actual needs, explains the information and checks the actual note; neither leaflet handover nor same-record save earns a labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approved leaflet versions and encounter headers can require repeated handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links and encounter forms can reuse existing identifiers without deciding care.
tasks.still_hard: Patient preferences and clinical suitability need an individual discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The midwife supports informed choice and checks understanding without pressure.

ambition.what: No automated contraceptive recommendation or prescription.

tasks.altitude: Small reductions in reference and header entry; clinical authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: A native reference library and encounter form can reuse approved documents and existing headers while clinical content remains clinician-authored.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover information provision and its actual note, not prescribing or eligibility assessment. OTHER is the clinical record application; native configuration is tried first.

s1 midwife captures actual patient needs and clinical context at full effort. Existing library owners maintain leaflet ID, version/date, topic and language; s2 handles missing/outdated content manually and checks the exact selected leaflet before handover. No leaflet content is generated.

s5 reuses only already recorded patient ID and encounter date, with actual counselling facts typed manually; absent headers are manually entered within retained effort. No patient choice, understanding or treatment is inferred. s6 checks the completed note, and edits require another check. Save/handover retain full human effort.
unknowns: Actual reference effort and proportion of note time spent entering headers
research_questions: Can approved leaflet links stay current in the existing clinical record?

incremental.description: Maintain leaflet links and encounter-header configuration

approvals.approved_version: exact selected family planning leaflet v1 checked for this patient in s2
actual family planning note v1 after completed-note check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing references and header reuse already work, leaving upkeep. High: four reference and1.5 header-entry hours saved less one upkeep, below central net4.7; clinical discussion and actual capture remain full.

tasks.short: Inform patients how to prepare and supply birth sites.

steps.what: Establish actual planned birth-site arrangements and patient questions and select the applicable approved preparation instructions
Prepare the exact birth-site preparation and supplies handout from selected approved sections
Check the complete handout against the actual site plan and approve the exact patient-facing version
Explain actual birth-site preparation and supplies to the patient and discuss practical questions and understanding
Give the exact approved preparation handout to the actual patient
Record the actual discussion and unresolved preparation issues and check the completed note
outputs: checked actual birth-site information note v1

steps.what: Save the checked actual birth-site information note in the same patient record
inputs: checked actual birth-site information note v1

tasks.design: Configure a handout assembled from selected approved sections in {DOCS}, using the actual site plan supplied by the midwife. The midwife checks the complete handout, explains it personally and records actual unresolved issues afterward; no supply order or readiness certification is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable preparation instructions can require repeated assembly for different birth-site arrangements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section templates can assemble selected approved material without generating clinical instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Practical understanding and changing birth-site arrangements need personal discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The midwife checks whether the patient can act on the information in their actual setting.

ambition.what: No new home-birth suitability or supply-order authority.

tasks.altitude: Less handout assembly; information and care decisions remain human.

evidence.claim: Controlled document templates can assemble approved instruction sections selected by a clinician.

assumptions: Provisional shares include actual site-plan capture, handout preparation, patient explanation and existing clinical note. OTHER is the clinical record application; native configuration is tried first.

s1 midwife captures actual intended site, known arrangements, patient questions and chosen instruction section IDs/version. The existing clinical library supplies approved section text and applicability; missing or conflicting guidance is resolved manually in s1, never invented. s2 changes only repeated section assembly and layout.

s3 approves the final handout before s5 delivery. s6 captures actual discussion facts and checks the completed note after the conversation; a changed note requires another check. Same-record save and actual handout delivery retain full effort. No statement that supplies are actually present is inferred from the handout.
unknowns: Actual repeated handout assembly and approved section coverage
research_questions: Can native templates preserve the selected approved sections without manual reformatting?

approvals.approved_version: birth-site preparation handout v1 checked in s3
actual birth-site information note v1 completed and checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: site-specific guidance needs full manual assembly and upkeep remains. High: six handout-assembly hours saved less one upkeep; actual explanation, note capture, handover and save stay full.

outputs: actual examination context and consent decision

steps.what: Perform the indicated gynecologic examination, breast examination and pap specimen collection with continuing patient communication
inputs: actual examination context and consent decision
outputs: actual examination findings and any collected specimen

steps.what: Capture actual examination findings and any actual specimen identifiers in the existing encounter form
inputs: actual examination findings and any collected specimen
existing patient ID and encounter date

steps.what: Interpret the findings, discuss actual next steps with the patient and check the completed clinical record
inputs: actual examination findings and any collected specimen
outputs: checked examination record and actual next-step discussion v1

steps.what: Save the checked examination record in the same clinical record
inputs: checked examination record and actual next-step discussion v1

tasks.design: Use the existing clinical encounter form {OTHER} to reuse recorded identity and date fields while keeping actual findings and specimen capture manual. The midwife obtains actual consent, performs the examination, interprets findings and checks the completed record; no physical care is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual findings are not available before examination and cannot be inferred from prior notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native encounter headers can avoid small amounts of repeated administrative entry.
tasks.still_hard: Physical examination, specimen handling, consent and clinical interpretation remain skilled care.
tasks.human_edge: The midwife examines carefully, responds to discomfort and interprets actual findings.

ambition.what: No automated examination, screening decision or clinical interpretation.

tasks.altitude: Negligible administrative change; the examination remains human.

evidence.claim: Native clinical encounter forms can reuse existing identity/date headers while actual findings remain clinician-entered.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover the examination, actual record and clinical discussion. The task statement is not a recommendation about screening frequency or eligibility. OTHER is the clinical record application.

s1 midwife obtains actual history and consent; s2 remains full physical care with continuing consent, and its gate records the midwife's confirmation of scope and actual patient consent, not a generated artifact approval.

s3 producer is the examining midwife, who captures actual findings and any collected specimen ID at full substantive effort. Only already-entered patient ID/date headers are reused; missing fields require manual entry in retained time. No planned specimen becomes proof of collection. Separate laboratory dispatch/orders are outside this examination boundary and require their own actual capture and gates if present.

s4 checks the completed clinical record and actual next-step discussion before s5; any edit restarts its check. Same-record save retains full human effort. Native configuration first; no added devices or model.
unknowns: Actual encounter-header repetition and laboratory handoff workflow
research_questions: Does native header reuse remove any actual re-entry beyond current configuration?

already_counted.description: Clinical interpretation, actual discussion and completed-record check

approvals.approved_version: actual examination scope and consent confirmed for this encounter in s1; any scope or consent change requires renewed confirmation
actual examination record v1 completed before the s4 check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: headers already populate and upkeep remains. High:1.5 repeated-header entry hours saved less half an upkeep hour; physical examination, actual findings, specimen capture and interpretation stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop, implement or evaluate individual midwifery care plans.

steps.what: Gather actual current assessment findings, patient preferences and previous plan results for this care episode
inputs: actual assessment findings and patient preferences
existing plan and actual care results

steps.what: Develop or revise individualized care actions, goals and review points with the patient using actual clinical judgement
Write the complete individualized plan from the actual agreed decisions in the clinical care-plan form
Check the completed plan against actual decisions, patient agreement and clinical context and approve its exact version
Commit the exact approved care plan in the same clinical record
Implement the relevant care actions personally and evaluate actual patient response against the agreed review points
inputs: actual patient condition and subsequent response
outputs: actual implemented care and evaluated response

steps.what: Capture actual implementation and evaluation results and check the completed follow-up note
inputs: actual implemented care and evaluated response

steps.what: Save the checked actual evaluation note in the same clinical record

tasks.design: Configure a structured care-plan form in the clinical record {OTHER}, reusing headers and selected existing plan fields while requiring explicit confirmation of current actions. Development decisions and actual implementation/evaluation remain human; the follow-up note is captured only after actual care.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plan layout and repeated episode fields compete with individualized care reasoning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse known headers and display prior plan fields for explicit correction.
tasks.still_hard: A plan must fit changing clinical findings and patient choices, and completion needs actual evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The midwife negotiates a suitable plan and changes it in response to actual care results.

ambition.what: No automated care recommendation, delivery or outcome judgement.

tasks.altitude: Less plan-format handling; clinical decisions and care remain human.

evidence.claim: Clinical care-plan forms can reuse existing headers and selected prior fields with clinician confirmation.

assumptions: Provisional shares represent a care-plan cycle; only relevant implementation/evaluation contribution is included. If the actual exam or other care is counted elsewhere, allocate that physical work once rather than adding duplicate savings. OTHER is the clinical record application; native configuration first.

s1 midwife captures actual findings, patient wishes and actual prior results at full effort. s2 produces goals, actions, responsible clinician and review conditions. s3 reuses existing patient/episode headers and layout, with all actual care actions entered/confirmed by the midwife; absent fields remain manual and no prior plan is silently carried forward.

s4 checks the completed plan before s5 commit. s6 observes actual implementation and response; s7 captures date, actual action, observed response and evaluation after that care, never from planned actions. Changed plan or note requires another respective final check. Same-record saves retain full effort and earn no saving.
No medication order, referral send or separate clinician assignment is automated; if included locally, split and count its own final-version gate and action.
unknowns: Actual repeated plan-form effort and proportion of care cycle covered
Existing cross-task ownership of physical care and observations
research_questions: Can native forms reduce layout without encouraging unverified carry-forward?

already_counted.description: Actual post-care evaluation capture and check

incremental.description: Maintain care-plan form fields and explicit carry-forward checks

approvals.approved_version: individualized care plan v1 checked after full plan completion
actual plan-evaluation note v1 completed after actual care and checked in s7
